summary: snapshot_to_plaintext makes its destination itself and, on any failure, removes that file by device+inode (and only side files that appeared during the copy), never through a link; a name that no longer holds its file is never returned. A removal that fails raises SnapshotLeftOnDisk: one fixed sentence x12 naming the path, no chained driver text. The encrypt tool never keeps a cut-short snapshot or re-removes a leftover by name; the route says it (500, or after the partial words). Older partials untouched.
